W38

Learning-content editor

/teach/courses/:courseId/content/:contentId/edit
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P47

Author accessible lessons from ordered blocks while keeping published pages stable until explicit publication.

Entry and return
W35 outline itemW37 add lessonW39 insert resource return
Layout regions
Block navigatorText, image, equation, file and embedded-media blocks with stable IDs
CanvasSelected block editor with heading hierarchy and descriptive link controls
RailAutosave, accessibility checks, resource usage and wide/narrow learner preview

States (4)
Unsaved draft
WhenTyping or block move
ShowsShow Saving then confirmed time only on success
Way outContinue editing

ShowsCount errors, focus first block and explain remedy

ShowsKeep local edits separate from published version
Way outReconnect and compare versions
Dialogs and drawers (2)
Discard local draft
  • Unsaved blocks and last confirmed save time
  • Published lesson remains available
Return without applying changesDiscard unsaved edits
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • A missing meaningful image alternative identifies its block and prevents publication.
  • Previewing does not record completion for any learner.
  • Failed autosave preserves typed content and never says All changes saved.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
  • TA authoring is disabled in initial HTML; listed authoring actions require a separately approved future grant.
